model.description: One row per reference area and year from the OECD Productivity Database, total economy, for OECD members, aggregates and the non-members the database covers, with GDP at current and constant purchasing power parity, GDP volume growth, population, employment, hours worked and the ratios that decompose GDP per inhabitant into GDP per hour, hours per worker and employment per inhabitant.
model.name: oecd_productivity_comparison

questions.derivation: Select each area's GDP volume growth and GDP per inhabitant at current PPP (for levels within a year) or constant 2020 PPP (for an area over time).
questions.question: How do GDP volume growth and GDP per inhabitant at purchasing power parity compare across OECD economies?

questions.derivation: GDP per inhabitant is exactly GDP per hour times hours per worker times employment per inhabitant, all derived from published totals; compare the three factors across areas within a year at current PPP, or follow their logs over time at constant PPP.
questions.question: How much of the level and evolution of GDP per inhabitant comes from productivity per hour, hours per worker and employment per inhabitant?

temporal.meaning: Each period is the first day of the calendar year whose flows, annual averages or change on the previous year the row carries.

validations.description: Each reference area appears once per year.
validations.name: one_row_per_area_and_year

validations.description: Every declared OECD member and aggregate is published.
validations.name: membership_list_matches_the_provider

validations.description: GDP per inhabitant equals GDP per hour times hours per worker times employment per inhabitant within a thousandth.
validations.name: per_capita_is_per_hour_times_hours_times_employment

validations.description: Derived GDP per inhabitant and per hour at current PPP reproduce the OECD's published values within a thousandth.
validations.name: derived_ratios_match_the_published_ones

validations.description: France carries every total in every year from 1970.
validations.name: france_is_complete_from_1970

validations.description: No area other than the two with known inconsistent provider totals fails the labour-input screen.
validations.name: only_new_zealand_and_peru_fail_the_labour_screen

validations.description: Published hours per worker lie within 1,000-3,500 and employment per inhabitant within 0.1-0.9.
validations.name: within_range
